comparison.objective: Lift and tip a wide box into a narrow slot on edge; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual compression grasp and edge-assisted reorientation differ from driver/wrench seating and torque regulation.
comparison.success_condition: Box upright in slot versus jam-nut seated, 90° setting retained, and three successful actuations.
comparison.reason: The task tests large-object reorientation, not mechanical setting retention.
